decision: Coarse state is decodable and fixed latent dynamics are predictable. Useful action/reward-sensitive world modeling and an online JEPA efficiency advantage remain unconfirmed. Do not promote joint Tiny or restart unchanged RL.

limits: Auxiliary predictors differ from RSSM in inputs, normalization, residual parameterization, optimizer and loss; do not isolate normalization or moving targets.
Readable positions and lower aggregate latent MSE do not establish bullet preservation or action/reward sufficiency.
Decoded future player-x loses to persistence in every seed, despite lower aggregate latent MSE; player-y only improves consistently at15steps.
Current-state reward ranking is moderately informative but unbounded readout scores are poorly calibrated; do not call them probabilities.
No reward-forecast advantage; forecast slices contain27/18positive events and3/7terminals.
Training normalized errors are lower than heldout errors; finite-capacity head failure is not proof that information is absent.
Offline privileged labels never enter the original actor, replay or policy; no gameplay competence claim.
Native RGB remains the qualified2Ddefault. Keep actor_critic_gradient off by default. No Phase3, larger unchanged campaign or swarm is started.
